data.action: 缩在长椅一侧抱膝沉思，吉他包靠在身旁
data.description: 【后藤一里 · 黄昏公园长椅】放学后的静谧街心公园，夕阳将天空染成温柔的金粉色。后藤一里独自坐在木质长椅一角，把下巴深深埋进粉色运动服的高领里，身旁放着心爱的黑色吉他包，静静看着飘落的晚霞落叶——「今天也没有鼓起勇气去搭话……不过，有吉他陪伴的黄昏，似乎也没有那么难熬。」
data.lighting: 金色落日逆光与柔和余晖轮廓光
data.promptProse: Hitori sits alone at one end of a park bench, burying her chin into the high collar of her pink tracksuit jacket. Her black guitar bag rests beside her above the dark school skirt and knee socks. The eye-level medium view includes falling leaves over the quiet path behind. Golden sunset backlight traces her hair and bench edge, while reflected evening light keeps the jacket's near folds softly visible.
data.title: 后藤一里 · 黄昏公园长椅
